plainTranslation: Mercury conjunct Neptune, you can be very sensitive to one another and have a subconscious understanding of what the other person is thinking, but you can also be delusional about the relationship and believe you're hearing from one another what you want, not what is actually being said.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
